gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diffuse Glioma; Glioblastoma; Adaptive Radiotherapy; Artificial Intelligence
Patients with IDH-negative GBM (stratum A) and IDH-mutant glioma (astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma) need radiotherapy (stratum B).

candidate_evidence.quote: [RADIATION] Adaptive radiotherapy: Volumetric and biological adaptive radiotherapy will be delivered based on interval imaging with MRI and PET scan during treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Use of prior radiotherapy to the head-neck region or brain or chemotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: Concurrent temozolomide is used for all patients undergoing radiation at the dose of 75 mg/m 2 of body surface area during the course of radiation with weekly monitoring on blood counts.

source_quote.quote: Patients with IDH-negative GBM (stratum A) and IDH-mutant glioma (astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma) need radiotherapy (stratum B).

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-only trial (adaptive RT guided by MRI/PET); no registered drug interventions. Temozolomide listed as soc_backbone because the description states concurrent temozolomide is used for all patients as standard institutional practice; it is not registered as an intervention. PET tracer (FET or F-DOPA) is not named definitively nor registered, so not listed. IDH status known is also an entry requirement (exclusion: IDH status unknown); IDH defines strata, not candidate-matched.
